name: say-it-back
description: After a long dictated message, Claude plays it back in four lines (asking, decided, not sure yet, changed) and waits for your yes before doing any work. Confirmed playbacks are saved as a dated record of what you meant.

min_words.title: Words before a playback
min_words.description: Messages at least this long get played back first.

log_folder.title: Where confirmed playbacks are saved
log_folder.description: A folder; one Markdown file per month. ~ means your home folder.
